final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested names and added MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. All 40 PCs use the resolver on pc34 (`10.15.9.12`).

The artificial root is on pc1; pc2–pc5 serve `com`, `net`, `edu`, and `it`. The remaining authoritative zones are on pc6, pc8–pc15, pc21, pc32, and pc33. Their BIND images, DNS files, and startup commands were added; existing addresses, routes, and connections were preserved.

I assumed IPv4, matching the lab’s existing configuration. Basic static checks passed, but BIND validation tools were unavailable locally; resolution still needs to be verified in the running lab.
